Quick technical notes before the kickoff: 

- Staging sizing: small Dedicated pool (2xA10G) should be sufficient for canary traffic footprint (we won't need full production capacity).
- Canary window: propose a 48h window with progressive traffic ramp (5% -> 25% -> 50%) and automated checks at each step.
- Monitoring signals to gate on: p95 latency not increasing >25% vs. baseline, error rate <0.5%, regression score delta <= 3% absolute against gold set, and business pass-rate (clinician accept) not below target.
- Rollback automation: use routing policy to shift traffic to a pinned fallback model variant (quantized t-variant) if any of the hard triggers fire. We'll also set an alert to PagerDuty and create a short-lived rollback incident channel in Slack.
- Eval harness integration: we'll expose a staging endpoint and a service account for Aditya to run batch evals; he can push results into a shared Drive CSV.

I'll draft a short runbook snippet and attach it (runbook_snippet.md). Any objections to the gating thresholds above?
